verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the SDK exposes the same tools, agent loop and context management as Claude Code, plus its filesystem features (CLAUDE.md, skills, hooks). The SDK also covers subagents, MCP, permissions, interactive user input, session resume and fork, streaming, image input and interrupts, so the core interactive experience is programmable. Missing for 10: no evidence that UI features like agent view, agent teams and dynamic workflows are exposed through the SDK; interrupts are unsupported in Python's simple query() mode; no explicit full-parity statement or independent hands-on confirmation.
